trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Technical negations only ('non-empty', 'non-zero', 'no infinite descending chains'). The closer's concessive 'Although the machinery is standard, its interpretation is novel' is contrast-shaped but its defect is the novelty claim itself, scored under closing-aphorism and meta-commentary.

trap-rhetorical-pivot.evidence: Proof steps (a)-(c) then admissibility then interpretation; the transitions are structural headers, not setup-then-reframe.

trap-em-dash.evidence: Four dash constructions in one proof block: 'such words - a finite set'; 'bounded degree - the Hecke relation is quadratic'; 'with time reversed - precisely the opposite braiding'; and the unspaced pair in the closing sentence 'its physical interpretation-formally linking ... arrow of time-is a novel conceptual contribution'. Density is the tell here, and three of the four append an afterthought where a full stop or colon is what is meant.
trap-em-dash.notes: Proposed: 'such words, a finite set.'; 'bounded degree; the Hecke relation is quadratic.'; 'with time reversed: the opposite braiding.'; the fourth disappears with the closing-sentence fix below. Not applied because the closer is being flagged structurally and the four should move together.

trap-triples.evidence: The C/P/T triple is the actual content of CPT symmetry (three named involutions with explicit formulas); the two-item 'two faces' list is a genuine pair.

trap-closing-aphorism.evidence: The block ends on a placed evaluative closer: 'Although the underlying mathematical machinery is a standard degree-lexicographic well-foundedness construction, its physical interpretation ... is a novel conceptual contribution introduced by the Quantum Observable Universe.' A proof block ends with the proof (the QED box is four paragraphs earlier); this is a self-assessment of significance, not mathematics.
trap-closing-aphorism.notes: Proposed (structural, .ts edit needed, not applied): delete the sentence from the .md and migrate it to authorNotes per AGENTS.md 4d, e.g. { kind: 'note', body: 'The degree-lex well-foundedness construction is standard; what is new here is the identification of the braid over/under structure with the thermodynamic arrow of time.' } Keeps the author's claim, removes it from the scholarly voice.

trap-meta-commentary.evidence: Same closing sentence narrates the significance of the author's own result ('is a novel conceptual contribution introduced by the Quantum Observable Universe'), naming the framework in the third person as the contributor. Category 6: place the contribution, do not announce it.
trap-meta-commentary.notes: Same proposed fix as the closing-aphorism entry: migrate to authorNotes.

trap-meta-commentary.evidence: no meta-commentary on the block's own rhetoric

trap-thesis-restatement.evidence: The closer evaluates rather than restates; the interpretive content (two faces, CPT) is genuinely new relative to the proof. Scored under closing-aphorism/meta-commentary instead.

trap-superlative.evidence: 'novel conceptual contribution' is self-promotion rather than an unqualified maximum-strength claim, and is scored under meta-commentary; 'precisely the opposite braiding' is exactness.

trap-nonspeakable.evidence: The closing sentence is a 45-word single clause with an embedded unspaced-dash appositive ('its physical interpretation-formally linking the categorical braid-over-under structure to the macroscopic thermodynamic arrow of time-is a novel conceptual contribution'); it parses on the page and stalls aloud.
trap-nonspeakable.notes: Resolved by the same structural fix (migrate to authorNotes). If kept in prose: 'The machinery is a standard degree-lexicographic well-foundedness argument. The interpretation is new: it links the braid over/under structure to the thermodynamic arrow of time.'
